data.label: Welcome Message
data.message:
Welcome to *AUTOGAMMA* 🚗✨

Car wash & detailing, coatings, PPF, sun control films and accessories - all under one roof.

Tap *Open Menu* below to get started. You can type *MENU* anytime to return here.

data.body: Choose what you're looking for and we'll show prices for your vehicle.
data.footer: All prices in ₹ (INR)

data.message:

Base prices start at:
• Washing - ₹200 (bikes) / ₹400 (cars)
• Detailing - ₹2,000 (bikes) / from ₹2,500 (cars)
• Graphene & Borophene coating - from ₹14,000
• Anti-rust coating - from ₹4,500
• Glass polishing & windshield coating - ₹1,500

Select your vehicle to see exact prices.

data.label: PPF Intro
data.message:
🛡️ *Paint Protection Film (PPF)*

Brands: Garware, Mash (by T&O), Jopasu, DHC, Dura Shield, Luminor, AS Guard & more - in gloss, matte and colour finishes.

*PPF starts from:*
• Bike - ₹10,000
• Scooty - ₹12,000
• Sports Bike - ₹15,000
• Small Cars / Hatchback - ₹45,000
• Mid-size Sedan / Compact SUV - ₹55,000
• SUV / MPV - ₹65,000

Warranty options range from 5 to 15 years.

data.label: PPF: Start
data.body: How would you like to proceed?
data.footer: Type MENU anytime for the main menu

data.label: PPF Warranty Guide
data.message:
📋 *PPF Warranty Guide*

*Garware TPU Gloss*
• Plus - 5 Years
• Glaze - 6 Years
• Premium - 8 Years
• Titanium - 15 Years

*Other films* (Mash, Jopasu, DHC, Dura Shield, Luminor, AS Guard, CLARO, Black Matt) - 5 Years

Some colour & matte films are available on request depending on roll stock.
